{07 06 00}This is awkward.{01 00 00 0f 00} You caught
me in the act. How'd you 
know I was skipping town?
Wha-what,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00}? You
didn't know? Well...who said
I was, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
Why, do you want me to

{07 06 00}See on piinlik.{01 00 00 0f 00} Sa tabasid
mu teolt. Kuidas teadsid, 
et ma linnast lahkun?
Mi-mida,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00}? Sa ei
teadnud? Noh...kes ütles,
et ma lahkun, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

lahkuksin {04 03 00}-st?

messages.en:
Hey, {01 00 00 0f 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 14 00} I wasn't
gonna tell anyone, but{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
I'm leaving {04 03 00}.
{07 16 00}Nobody's ever nice to me.{01 00 00 0f 00}
Except you. {01 00 00 0f 00}Sometimes.{01 00 00 0f 00}

You've got to carry on the
curmudgeon torch when
I'm gone, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:

kavatsenud seda öelda,{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
ma lahkun {04 03 00}-st.
{07 16 00}Keegi pole minu vastu kena.{01 00 00 0f 00}

edasi kandma, kui ma
olen läinud, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 14 00} I'm gonna
give it to you straight{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}

{07 15 00}I'm leaving this awful town!
And don't try to stop me,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
I know who my friends are,
and they're all somewhere
else!
messages.et:
Hei, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 14 00} Ma ütlen
sulle otse{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}

{07 15 00}Ma lahkun sellest jubedast
linnast! Ja ära ürita mind
peatada, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
Ma tean, kes on mu sõbrad,
ja nad on kõik
kuskil mujal!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Sorry, kid.{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 15 00}My mind is more
set than concrete,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 16 00}Quit tryin' to change my
mind, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 06 00}I've made my decision and
I'm stickin' with it!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Lõpeta mu meele muutmise
üritamine, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 06 00}Ma olen otsuse teinud ja
jään selle juurde!

messages.en:
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, you're the only
one who tried to stop me,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 15 00}Thanks for sticking with
me. It's nice to be wanted.
Maybe I'll reconsider...
messages.et:
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, sa oled ainus,
kes üritas mind peatada,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 15 00}Aitäh, et sa minuga oled.
On kena olla soovitud.
Ehk mõtlen ma ümber...
